query:
-- Total sem cat9 (faturamento operacional real, sem o Dpote distribuído diariamente)
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as dias,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
      CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
      CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_sem_cat9,
  SUM(CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_cat9_banco,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
      CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + 
      CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_com_cat9_banco
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data LIKE '2026-03-%'
  AND empresaSlug IN ('MORUMBI', 'MASCOTE')
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
